column43: Stream is dry, extensive beaver activities throughout of assessed length. Seasonal stream, potentially used as migratory corridor to u/s reaches for ST if spawning habitat exists. The corridor is negatively affected by beaver dams. Existence of spawning habitat should be evaluated - access not granted in 2024. The stream is mismapped by TRIM, it was GPS'd on Oct 10, 2024 from the crossing to the mouth. ~500m section of channel from the mouth is overgrown by perennial plants (grassess and sedges) and is used by cattle as a trail. No alluvium was observed. The stream is flooded only during freshet and may remain watered for ~2 months; however it is likely passable to ST up to the end of Reach 1. Unknown if spawning habitat for ST is present beyond the crossing. The stream may also be used as a refuge or rearing habitat for CO and CH when watered, but is unusable for overwintering. Overall the stream in R1 does not contain preferable habitat for ST or RB.
